From the archive

Back issues, 1990 to 2025 Jenny Eclair and Judith Holder

Every live show of the podcast, from a festival field in Suffolk to the Christmas matinees in Leicester Square.

After that are the Grumpy Old Women stage shows written by Jenny and Judith, then Jenny's own tours, the books, telly, and radio they've both created along the way.

  • Jenny's solo shows
  • Wider work
  • Venues

Jenny and Judith's shows

Jenny and Judith created Older and Wider and Grumpy Old Women together. Since the podcast started, they've taken Older and Wider on stage together. Previously, they toured the Grumpy Old Women stage shows over several years.

Older and Wider live

Shows marked "Date uncertain" or "Date and venue uncertain" indicate a show where we do not know the exact date / venue. The 2019 Hebden Bridge show was announced, and the 2023 work in progress show was mentioned on the podcast, but we do not have a confirmed date / venue for either.

Grumpy Old Women

Jenny and Judith wrote these shows together. Jenny was in the cast of most of them, while Judith stayed off the stage. In autumn 2007 a different cast took the first show on a UK tour, so Jenny was not on stage for any of those dates.

As with Jenny's solo shows, the dates come from old copies of jennyeclair.com and grumpyoldwomenlive.com, kept by the Internet Archive, so a few shows may be missing. In all, there are 326 dates. The Australian seasons ran for several nights each, so they are not in this total.

Jenny's solo shows

Jenny was on stage long before the podcast. These are her own tours and her Edinburgh Fringe shows, latest first. Judith is not on stage in any of them.

Coming up

No solo dates are on sale at the moment. New shows go up first on jennyeclair.com.

Earlier tours

These are the dates that were announced on old copies of jennyeclair.com and grumpyoldwomenlive.com, kept by the Internet Archive. A show can move or be cancelled after it is announced, and some years have gaps, so a few shows may be missing. In all, there are 599 solo dates.

Wider work

A short list of the books, telly and radio of each host.

Jenny Eclair

  • Perrier Award, Edinburgh Fringe

    1995. Jenny was the first woman to win the award with her show, Prozac and Tantrums.

    Source: Wikipedia

  • Camberwell Beauty

    First novel, published by Little, Brown and Company, 2000.

    Camberwell Beauty on Amazon

    Source: Wikipedia

  • Life, Death and Vanilla Slices

    Novel, published by Sphere, 2012.

    Life, Death and Vanilla Slices on Amazon

    Source: Wikipedia

  • Moving

    Novel, published by Sphere, 2015.

    Moving on Amazon

    Source: Wikipedia

  • Jokes, Jokes, Jokes

    Memoir, published by Sphere, 2024. It was followed by a tour of the same name.

    Jokes, Jokes, Jokes on Amazon

    Source: Chortle

  • Grumpy Old Women

    BBC Two, 2004 to 2007. A regular voice on the series.

    Grumpy Old Women on BBC Programmes

    Source: Wikipedia

  • Loose Women

    ITV. A panellist in 2003, and again from 2011 to 2012.

    Source: Wikipedia

  • I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!

    ITV, 2010. Jenny came third.

    Source: Wikipedia

  • Taskmaster

    Series 15, 2023. Jenny came third.

    Taskmaster on Channel 4

    Source: Wikipedia

  • Little Lifetimes

    BBC Radio 4, 2014 to 2022. Short monologues written, and sometimes performed, by Jenny.

    Little Lifetimes on BBC Programmes

    Source: British Comedy Guide

Judith Holder

  • The Dame Edna Experience

    Producer of the first series, 1987. Nominated for the BAFTA TV Award for Best Light Entertainment Programme in 1988.

    Source: British Comedy Guide

    BAFTA nomination: IMDb

  • After They Were Famous

    Producer and executive producer of three episodes, 2001 to 2002. Nominated for the BAFTA TV Award for Best Features in 2002, for the episode "The Sound of Music - Children".

    Source: IMDb

  • Grumpy Old Women

    BBC Two, 2004 to 2007. Judith created the series and was its executive producer. She also narrated the third series.

    Grumpy Old Women on BBC Programmes

    Source: Wikipedia

  • The Grumpy Guide To...

    Writer and executive producer of the second series, 2007.

    The Grumpy Guide To on BBC Programmes

    Source: British Comedy Guide

  • Grumpy Old Women, the book

    Published by BBC Books, 2006.

    Grumpy Old Women on Amazon

    Source: Penguin

  • The Secret Diary of a Grumpy Old Woman

    Published by Orion, 2006.

    The Secret Diary of a Grumpy Old Woman on Amazon

    Source: Orion

  • Grumpy Old Holidays

    Published by Orion, 2007.

    Grumpy Old Holidays on Amazon

    Source: Orion

Jenny and Judith together

    The stage show that first toured in November 2005, and led to three more shows.
